list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry in its own words; official names and descriptions are quoted as published.
note: Hidden trophies stay hidden on PlayStation until earned. Missable flags are built from the official descriptions plus community reporting that there is no mission replay: keep a manual save before any trophy flagged missable. No online trophies exist in this list: every trophy is single-player.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story: chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission.
Clear every trophy flagged missable while you play, with a manual save before each one.
Finish the collectibles, activities and grinds in stages 3 and 4 of the roadmap.
This trophy pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks.
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it unlocks automatically the moment your 54th other trophy pops, so there is no separate task to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, missables as you go, collectibles and grinds last — and this one takes care of itself. Expect a long haul: community estimates put the full list at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission's beats.
Reach the mission's end screen: the trophy pops as it completes.
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, so it is the first story trophy most players earn and it cannot be missed: simply play Gone Fishing from the start of the game through to its end screen. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned because its name gives away the opening mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 in story order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete screen appears.

Story chapter trophies are unmissable — you earn them by playing through — but they are hidden on PlayStation until earned, so the spoiler setting in this guide keeps them covered until you tick them off.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and every stranger mission strand.
Complete the collectibles: cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicles, exploration.
Finish the activities: stunts, shooting range golds, races, challenges.
Open the in-game stats page and clear the last checklist items until it reads 100%.
trophies.guide: The second gold trophy and the real endgame: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. It is not the same as the platinum — 100% is one checklist inside the game, while the platinum also needs the one-off feats and grinds — but the two overlap heavily, so the roadmap's stages 3 and 4 are built to feed this trophy. Track it in the game's own stats page, not just here, and leave it for last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find stunt jumps, ramps and airtime spots around Leonida.
Land jumps cleanly to bank each stunt toward the 250 total.
Check the in-game stats counter between sessions to track progress.
Keep a fast bike handy: stunts come quicker on two wheels.
trophies.guide: A pure grind trophy: pull off 250 stunts — jumps, airtime and clean landings — anywhere in Leonida. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every jump you land from the opening hours counts. It pairs naturally with the driving you already do for races and exploration, so let it build up and only farm the remainder at the end.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Open the activities list in the game and note the 9 activity types.
Try one of each: a race, a shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, and the rest.
The trophy pops once the last untried type is sampled.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or finish anything — one attempt at each type is enough. It is the natural first step into the activities, and a good way to discover which ones you want to grind for the other activity trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list (42 challenges).
Learn each challenge's gold score threshold before spending ammo.
Work through them weapon by weapon, replaying any that fall short of gold.
The trophy pops when the last challenge shows a gold medal.
trophies.guide: The hardest skill trophy on the list: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold threshold, so treat it as a practice routine — learn the targets and timing per weapon, then run them in batches. It is a silver for a reason; leave it until the story is done and you can focus on it without distractions.
